statements.t: In July 2026, the Company restarted patient enrollment and treatment in the INVINCIBLE-4 Study and is currently targeting complete enrollment by the end of 2027.
We plan to provide an update upon completion of IDMB review in the first quarter of 2027.
We look forward to receiving our partner's planned IDMB report of the safety data and conclusions on the skin issue of these newly treated patients in Q1 2027.
Assuming a positive report, we will have confidence that the skin issue is resolved.
